## Purpose
Renders the run screen's "Files" tab: the downloadable deliverable(s) for a completed or in-flight run, dispatched by `workflowType` into per-pipeline layouts (single-deliverable hero for user_stories/ppt/prototype/custom, a multi-section doc+code layout for app_builder, plus a generic-deliverable fallback row for any other pipeline type).

## Shape
- `FilesTab` — the exported component; builds a `FileItem[]` from props (deliverable content, per-agent outputs, generic deliverable), then renders either the app_builder multi-section layout or the single-deliverable hero-plus-agent-outputs layout, plus shared "Run input" and "From v{n-1} base version" sections.
- `deriveDeliverableFiles` / `deriveDeliverableFilename` — pure, exported helpers that derive a `FileItem`/filename from `workflowType` + content, dispatching purely on the structural `workflowType` string (never a fabricated branch) so the Files tab and Preview tab always agree.
- `parseCodeFiles` / `parseAppBuilderFiles` — parse ```` ```filename: path ```` / `### path` / bold-path code-block conventions out of agent markdown output into individual code `FileItem`s (app_builder only).
- `runInputFileRows` — derives `prompt.md`/`clarifications.md` rows from the raw run input and answered clarify rounds.
- `handleDownload` / `downloadBlob` (exported) — the single blob-download path, with special-cased branches for `project.zip` (lazy-loads JSZip from a CDN) and a legacy PPTX export call.
- UI pieces — the dark "Final output" hero (and its live-building variant), the agent-outputs timeline, `SectionHeader`, the collapsible base-version section.

## Why this shape
Deliverable derivation is centralized in exported pure helpers specifically so the Files tab and the Preview tab never disagree on filename/content (stated inline, INV-12); the generic-deliverable row and the building/settled hero variants exist to keep the component "type-agnostic" (SC-001, repeated throughout) — new pipeline types get a working file list without a new bespoke branch.
